name: Collectalytics
description:
Pick one of your collections, or paste the link to any public one, and Collectalytics reads it and counts.

See how many unique creators you have collected and how much of the collection the top ones hold. See your most recent picks, with how long since each creator was last added, and how many new names each stretch of additions brought in. Look up a creator to see everything you have added from them and where it sits in the collection.

A stats snippet, with the collection linked by name, copies straight into an article, model or post description. The collection you had open, your edits to the snippet and a short list of the public collections you opened by link are kept for next time. Only you can see either, and you can empty them from your Civitai account settings.

The app only reads your collections. It never changes them.
